name: HE-Grenade
description: A high-explosive grenade. Click to pull the pin, then hold and let go to throw it: it bounces and goes off 2.5 seconds later, hurting everyone near and blowing bricks loose. Each one is used up when thrown, so carry a few. Our own remake of the High Explosive Grenade by TheGeek, Pload, Rotondo and Ephialtes: new model, effects and sounds, same blast.
